committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects state educational agencies, local educational agencies, early childhood education programs, and students.
dimensions.evidence: competitive CLSD grants to state educational agencies (SEAs) and, through them, competitive subgrants to local educational agencies

dimensions.assessment: Restricts certain teaching methods and adds funding priorities rather than restructuring the entire educational system.
dimensions.evidence: excludes the use of a three-cueing model, and (2) requires the Department of Education and SEAs to prioritize awarding CLSD grants

dimensions.assessment: Applies to existing federal funds awarded under the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 on or after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: apply with respect to funds awarded under the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965

dimensions.assessment: Amends definitions and application priorities for Comprehensive Literacy State Development grants under federal law.
dimensions.evidence: Section 2221(b) of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 6641(b)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory changes to grant criteria under the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965.
dimensions.evidence: shall apply with respect to funds awarded under the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965

missing_information: No specific dollar amounts or overall funding level changes are stated in the text.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill prioritizes literacy instruction aligned with the science of reading within federal grant programs while excluding three-cueing instructional models.
